description: TianFeng Patches 0.0.1-dev.6 development prerelease. YouTube Music 9.34.52 Android Auto MediaBrowser search is now self-contained with caller certificate compatibility, Google-signature verifier avoidance, and the search_media_items package-identity fix. Enables search, speech-to-text search, search results and result selection without modifying Premium entitlements. Truecaller Hide ads and Disable analytics patches remain included.
